name: What should I do immediately after my listing expires?

mainEntity.name: What should I do immediately after my listing expires?

acceptedAnswer.text: Immediately after your listing expires, it's beneficial to take a step back and avoid making hasty decisions. Review your previous agent agreement to understand your obligations and options. Then, consider requesting a detailed market analysis to understand current conditions and potential reasons your property didn't sell. Gathering all previous listing details, including photos and marketing descriptions, can help a new agent quickly assess and plan a fresh strategy.
acceptedAnswer.description: After an expired listing, review your previous agreement and gather listing details. Consider a new market analysis to inform your next steps.
